tools.name: list_database_tables
tools.description: Lists all available database tables in the public schema

tools.name: get_table_schema
tools.description: Returns the exact columns, types, and foreign key relationships for a given PostgreSQL table.

table_name.description: Name of the table to inspect

tools.name: list_documentation_topics
tools.description: Lists all available documentation topics from the docs/ directory

tools.name: read_documentation
tools.description: Reads the content of a specific documentation file from the docs/ directory

file_path.description: The path to the documentation file (e.g., developers/webhooks.md)

tools.name: list_webhook_events
tools.description: Lists all available webhook event topics (e.g., sales_order.created)

tools.name: get_webhook_payload_schema
tools.description: Gets the payload schema and envelope structure for a given webhook event topic

tools.name: list_api_domains
tools.description: Lists all available API domains that can be passed to get_api_endpoints.

tools.name: get_api_endpoints
tools.description: Get available API endpoints for a given domain. Valid domains are: crm, customer, delivery_address, general_ledger, payment, product, project, purchase_invoice, purchase_order, purchase_return, sales_invoice, sales_order, sales_return, supplier, system, tax, transfer_order, warehouse.

domain.description: The domain to list endpoints for

tools.name: call_herobm_api
tools.description: Call a HeroBM API endpoint by its exact name returned by get_api_endpoints.

endpoint_name.description: The exact endpoint name to call (e.g., purchase_order_create)

arguments.description: The arguments (path parameters, query parameters, body) for the endpoint as defined in its schema

tools.name: list_build_targets
tools.description: Lists all available Makefile build targets and their descriptions
